title: Identify the specified single-chart comparison hom
statement: For one affine open U of a scheme Y, coefficient modules M,N with M quasi-coherent, a specified affine presentation and projective resolution P of M on U, and global K-flat resolutions K to M[0] and F to N[0], the hom of tensorResolutionChartComparisonIso in every integer degree equals the hom of tensorResolutionComparison applied to the chart resolution, its augmentation, and the restrictions of K,F,q,s. Use the literal restricted coefficient complexes and the bundled section ring throughout. This identifies one specified isomorphism and has no chart-change map or naturality conclusion. Definitions: [def-pc-kflat-complex], [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology].

source.place: Tag 06YT, comparison through a common K-flat resolution; Tag 08DX(2), affine derived tensor computation.

proof.text: Unfold only tensorResolutionChartComparisonIso. Its local terms are exactly the displayed restriction functor, chart resolution, augmentation, and restricted maps. Proof irrelevance identifies the K-flatness and quasi-isomorphism certificates. The hom projections are definitionally equal, so reflexivity closes the goal without unfolding tensorResolutionComparison or any tensor totalization.

proof_origin.place: Tag 06YT, comparison through a common K-flat resolution; Tag 08DX(2), affine derived tensor computation.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorResolutionChartComparisonIso_hom_eq
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (M N : Y.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (MA : ModuleCat.{u} (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u))
    (sM : MA ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)] M.val.obj (op U.1))
    (P : ProjectiveResolution MA) (K F : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ)
    (q : K ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj M)
    (s : F ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj N)
    (hK : CochainComplex.IsKFlatTensor (R := Y.sheaf) K)
    (hF : CochainComplex.IsKFlatTensor (R := Y.sheaf) F)
    (hq : QuasiIso q) (hs : QuasiIso s) (i : ℤ) :
  let R := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec
  let RC := R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
  let E := tensorResolutionChartComplex U MA P
  let M0 := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj M
  let N0 := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj N
  let r := tensorResolutionChartAugmentation M U MA sM P
  let hE : CochainComplex.IsKFlatTensor (R := (Spec Γ(Y, U.1)).sheaf) E :=
    tensorResolution_isKFlat_bundledRing Γ(Y, U.1) MA P
  let hK' := isKFlat_restrict U.2.fromSpec K hK
  let hF' := isKFlat_restrict U.2.fromSpec F hF
  letI : QuasiIso q := hq
  letI : QuasiIso s := hs
  let hq' : QuasiIso (RC.map q) := by dsimp [RC, R]; infer_instance
  let hs' : QuasiIso (RC.map s) := by dsimp [RC, R]; infer_instance
  (tensorResolutionChartComparisonIso Y M N U MA sM P K F q s hK hF hq hs i).hom =
  (tensorResolutionComparison (Spec Γ(Y, U.1)).sheaf E (RC.obj K) (RC.obj M0)
    (RC.obj F) (RC.obj N0) r (RC.map q) (RC.map s) hE hK' hF'
    (tensorResolutionChartAugmentation_quasiIso M U MA sM P) hq' hs' i).hom
